title: Copilot in Enterprise, Fusion GA, Opus 4.8 fast mode ends
summary: In short: [GitHub Enterprise now includes access to GitHub Copilot](https://github.blog/changelog/2026-10-28-github-enterprise-now-includes-access-to-github-copilot/) (account-team customers on Enterprise Cloud for now): Copilot for every licensed user, with AI usage metered from the first request against the enterprise budget and no monthly AI credits per seat; [Route and orchestrate models with GitHub Copilot Fusion](https://github.blog/changelog/2026-10-28-route-and-orchestrate-models-with-github-copilot-fusion/): Generally available; Copilot picks the models for each prompt, you pick the effort level, and it only uses models your policies enable; [Claude Code v2.1.316](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/releases/tag/v2.1.316): Opus 4.8 fast mode will be removed on 30 November; after that, fast mode requests on Opus 4.8 return an error and do not fall back to standard Opus 4.8

items.title: Claude Code v2.1.311
items.text: Changed `ultrathink` in the interactive terminal to run its turn at xhigh effort on Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5, Haiku 5.5 and Fable 5.1 through Anthropic's API; typed while Claude is working, it raises the rest of that turn

items.title: GPT-6.1 Terra in Work and Codex
items.text: GPT-6.1 Terra is now available in ChatGPT Work and Codex on Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise, and Edu plans.

items.title: GitHub Copilot assisted permissions generally available
items.text: When Copilot requests permission to run a command, access a file system path, or open a URL, a large language model evaluates the request.

items.title: GPT-6.1 Terra in GitHub Copilot
items.text: GPT-6.1 Terra, OpenAI’s newest model, is now generally available in GitHub Copilot.

items.title: Claude Code v2.1.312
items.text: Changed Claude Code to stop sending the `claude_code.safety_event` OpenTelemetry event

items.title: Codex 0.165.0
items.text: Enabled memory v2 by default for fresh profiles and added support for importing external-agent memories into it.

items.title: GitHub Copilot supports server-to-server authentication
items.text: GitHub Copilot now supports server-to-server authentication for GitHub Apps installed on organizations, available in public preview.

items.title: Agent Merge watches and fixes pull requests in the cloud
items.text: When a selected blocker appears, Copilot starts working in a cloud development environment to fix it.

items.title: Build shared workflows for your team with Copilot Automations
items.text: Shared Copilot Automations are rolling out, enabling teams to build and maintain AI-powered workflows together.

items.title: Generate and edit images directly in Copilot
items.text: You can now generate and edit images using natural language in GitHub Copilot.

items.title: GitHub Agentic Workflows generally available
items.text: Define your automation in natural language Markdown files, and GitHub Agentic Workflows compiles them into standard Actions YAML.

items.title: GitHub Copilot app, Universe releases
items.text: Copilot Projects are now in public preview.

items.title: GitHub Copilot Fusion now supports selection of local models
items.text: Today we are shipping intelligent routing for local models into experimental preview.

items.title: GitHub Copilot in VS Code, Universe releases
items.text: The Copilot harness, built on the Microsoft Copilot SDK, is now the default for new sessions in both the editor and the Agents window.

items.title: GitHub Copilot SDK is becoming Microsoft Copilot SDK
items.text: No immediate changes are required for existing users.

items.title: GitHub Enterprise now includes access to GitHub Copilot
items.text: Enterprises working with a GitHub or Microsoft account team can now get Copilot included with GitHub Enterprise for every licensed user.

items.title: GitHub intelligence puts your code, context, and history to work
items.text: Changes to checked-in skills and instructions are proposed in pull requests for your team to review.

items.title: Repository plugin defaults and enterprise plugin controls generally available
items.text: Trusted repositories can install and enable default plugins for contributors.

items.title: Route and orchestrate models with GitHub Copilot Fusion
items.text: Instead of picking a model for each task, choose Copilot Fusion and let Copilot intelligently route and orchestrate which models it uses for you.

items.title: Security extension for the GitHub Copilot app
items.text: You can now work through your repository’s GitHub code scanning alerts without leaving the GitHub Copilot app.

items.title: Codex 0.166.0
items.text: Added keyboard-driven transcript selection with word, line, and page motions, integrated search, and configurable shortcuts.

items.title: Claude Code v2.1.314
items.text: Added `permissions.blockWritesOutsideWorkingDirectories`: Write, Edit and NotebookEdit refuse paths outside the working directories in every permission mode

items.title: Claude Code v2.1.316
items.text: Deprecated fast mode for Opus 4.8 as of October 30, 2026; it will be removed on November 30, 2026.
